name: get_client_state
description: Get the live state of everything a customer owns: VPS machines, MT5 terminals/accounts (balance, equity, margin), every running EA instance with its effective inputs, open positions and pending orders with per-EA attribution, and VPS health. Call this FIRST for any question or action: it returns the account_id and instance_id values that every command needs. If `stale` is true the agent has not reported recently and numbers may be old. Maps to GET /v1/clients/{client_id}/state.

client_id.description: The customer's identifier in the calling platform.

include.description: Optional comma-separated sections to include (accounts,instances,positions,orders,vps). Default: everything.

name: list_eas
description: List the Expert Advisors available in the catalog with their ea_id, description, category (grid/scalper/news), risk presets (e.g. low/medium/high), allowed symbols, and whether they support a soft stop. Use it to map what the user says ("Tidepool", "the Asian-session scalper") to an ea_id and to show which presets exist. Does not include the parameter list; call get_ea for that. Maps to GET /v1/eas.

client_id.description: Optional. When given, limits the list to EAs this customer is licensed to use.

name: get_ea
description: Get one EA's full description: every caller-visible input with its exact name, label, explanation, type, default, whether it can be changed, the allowed range, and whether changing it should be confirmed with the user first (risk-related). Always call this before proposing a parameter change so you use the exact input name and a value inside the allowed range. Maps to GET /v1/eas/{ea_id}.

ea_id.description: Catalog id, e.g. tidepool_grid, lantern_scalper_pro, lattice_ai, headline_runner.

name: start_ea
description: Start an EA on a customer's account with a risk preset (add an EA). Asynchronous: returns a command_id and status `queued`; call get_command with wait to learn the outcome. Use dry_run=true first to get a human-readable summary and diff to confirm with the user, then call again without dry_run. Fails with a clear error if the EA is not in the catalog, the symbol is not allowed, or the instance limit is reached. Maps to POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/commands with type=start_ea.

account_id.description: From get_client_state of THIS client; never guess or reuse an id from another conversation.

preset.description: Risk preset id from list_eas (e.g. low, medium, high). Defaults to the EA's default preset.

symbol.description: Optional chart symbol; must be in the EA's symbols_allowed. Defaults to the EA's default.

timeframe.description: Optional chart timeframe. Defaults to the EA's default.

inputs.description: Optional input overrides on top of the preset, keyed by exact input name from get_ea. Only whitelisted inputs are accepted.

dry_run.description: If true, validate and return the summary/diff without starting anything.

reason.description: The user's request in their words, for the audit trail.

name: stop_ea
description: Stop a running EA instance. mode=soft (default): the EA stops opening new trades but stays on the chart and keeps managing its open positions until they close on their own; the instance becomes `paused`. mode=hard: the EA is removed from the chart; open positions and pending orders are left untouched and unmanaged, which is dangerous for grid EAs with an open basket. Positions are never closed by this tool. Asynchronous: poll with get_command. Maps to POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/commands with type=stop_ea.

instance_id.description: From get_client_state of THIS client; never guess or reuse an id from another conversation.

name: set_risk
description: Switch a running EA instance to a different risk preset (e.g. low/medium/high from list_eas). This restarts the EA with the preset's lot-sizing inputs; the response's `resolved.diff` shows exactly which inputs change from what to what. Refused with RESTART_UNSAFE if the EA has open positions and its restart safety is not verified. Use dry_run=true to show the user the diff before applying. Asynchronous: poll with get_command. Maps to POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/commands with type=set_risk.

name: set_param
description: Change one or more inputs of a running EA instance (e.g. MaximumSpread to 15). Use the exact input names and allowed ranges from get_ea; anything not on the whitelist is refused with PARAM_NOT_CHANGEABLE or PARAM_OUT_OF_RANGE and a message you can relay. Every change restarts the EA; the response shows the was → now diff. Inputs flagged requires_confirmation in get_ea should be confirmed with the user first (use dry_run=true to get the summary). Asynchronous: poll with get_command. Maps to POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/commands with type=set_param.

inputs.description: Input name → new value. Booleans as booleans, numbers as numbers, enums as their integer index, comma-separated lists as strings.

name: restart_ea
description: Restart a running EA instance, optionally changing inputs at the same time ("restart Lantern Scalper with MaxSpread 15"). Without inputs it re-applies the current configuration, which is useful when an instance shows status `error`. With inputs it behaves like set_param. Asynchronous: poll with get_command. Maps to POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/commands with type=restart_ea.

inputs.description: Optional input changes, same rules as set_param.

name: run_backtest
description: Run a Strategy Tester backtest of an EA on the customer's own VPS (a second, isolated MetaTrader terminal next to the live ones; below-normal priority, one core where possible, one test per VPS at a time). The customer chooses the period (from/to, dates up to today), the tick modelling (every_tick_real = most faithful, needs real tick history; every_tick; one_minute_ohlc = fast first look; open_prices = fastest, rough), the symbol, the timeframe, the preset and optional input overrides. Deposit, currency and leverage default to the live account's. CONSENT: the test loads the customer's VPS, so before the first run call with dry_run=true, show the returned `consent_text` (it states the VPS's cores and RAM) and the summary, and get an explicit yes; then call again with consent=true. Later runs still need a yes to the summary but no consent text (dry run returns requires_consent=false). Asynchronous: 202 + command_id; poll get_command with wait=30 repeatedly (runs take minutes to an hour); the final command has result.backtest (net_profit, max_drawdown_pct, profit_factor, trades, win_rate_pct, sharpe, expected_payoff, initial_deposit, history_quality_pct, duration_s) and result.report_url (full HTML report; the dashboard shows a link). Maps to POST /v1/backtests.

account_id.description: The account whose VPS and terminal run the test (its login gives history and the EA licence).

preset.description: Risk preset id from get_ea; defaults to the EA's default preset.

inputs.description: Optional exact input overrides on top of the preset (names from get_ea).

symbol.description: Defaults to the EA's default symbol; must be in its allowed list.

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD, not later than today.

deposit.description: Initial deposit; defaults to the account balance.

consent.description: true once the customer explicitly accepted the consent_text of the dry run.

dry_run.description: Validate and show the plan, the warnings and the consent status without running.

name: get_command
description: Get the status and outcome of a command created by start_ea / stop_ea / set_risk / set_param / restart_ea / run_backtest. Pass wait (up to 30 seconds) to block until the command finishes instead of polling. Terminal statuses: succeeded, failed, rejected, expired, cancelled. The `summary` field is a one-sentence, user-safe description of what happened; `resolved.diff` is what was applied; `result.observed` is what the terminal actually shows afterwards; `error` explains a failure; for run_backtest, `result.backtest` holds the metrics and `result.report_url` the report. Maps to GET /v1/commands/{command_id}.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for completion, 0–30. Use 30.

name: list_commands
description: List recent commands on an account (audit trail): what was requested, by whom, when, and the outcome. Use it to answer "what did you change recently?" or to find a command that is still in flight before creating a new one for the same instance. Maps to GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}/commands.

name: get_account_history
description: Closed deals on an account, each attributed to an ea_id / instance_id by magic number. Use it for per-EA results over a period. Defaults to the last 7 days. Reporting logic (weekly summaries, recommendations) is the caller's job; this tool only supplies attributed raw deals. Maps to GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}/history.

name: get_equity_curve
description: Balance / equity of an account over time with a drawdown summary. source=samples (default): balance and equity sampled about once a minute, kept 90 days, shows floating P&L — use for 'how did equity move this week'. source=deals: the balance after every deal of the whole account history, any period — use for 'draw my balance curve', 'growth since the start', anything older than 90 days. The dashboard renders the result as a chart automatically, so after calling it give a two-line takeaway (change over the window, max drawdown) instead of listing points. Maps to GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}/equity.

from.description: ISO 8601 date-time. Default: 7 days before `to` (samples) or the first deal (deals).

step.description: Seconds per point (60–86400). Default fits about 400 points.

name: get_pnl
description: Closed profit and loss of an account grouped by ea (default), instance, symbol, day, hour (of day, 00–23) or weekday (Mon–Sun): per group deals, wins/losses, profit, win rate, profit factor, average result and max drawdown, plus cumulative curves. Use it for 'which EA earned most', 'how did last week go', 'win rate by symbol', 'which hours / weekdays are profitable', 'drawdown by EA'. Hours and weekdays are in the broker's server time. The dashboard renders the groups as a histogram (profit / win rate / drawdown / deals, switchable) and the cumulative curve as a line, so summarise the picture in words rather than repeating every number. Defaults to the last 30 days; pass `from` for longer periods (the whole history is available). Maps to GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}/pnl.

name: list_my_eas
description: The customer's OWN Expert Advisors being onboarded (status uploaded → installed → discovered → drafted → confirmed, or failed) and every .ex5 file the agent found under MQL5\Experts on their VPS (`on_vps`, with catalog_ea_id / custom_id when known). Use it when the customer wants to add, upload or onboard an EA, or asks about an EA that is not in list_eas. A new file is uploaded by the customer in the dashboard (app.algohand.com → Your EAs) or through the API; once uploaded, the agent installs it and reads its inputs by itself and the entry moves to `drafted`. Maps to GET /v1/clients/{client_id}/eas.

name: onboard_vps_ea
description: Start onboarding an EA that is ALREADY on the customer's VPS (pick `file` and `path` from list_my_eas.on_vps): the agent reads its inputs on a throw-away chart with algo trading off, then an AI draft of the profile is prepared. Asynchronous: the response carries a command; call list_my_eas / get_ea_draft after ~30 s. Ask the customer for a link to the EA's description or manual (source_url) if they have one — it improves the draft. Maps to POST /v1/clients/{client_id}/eas with from_vps.

file.description: File name from on_vps, e.g. GoldScalper.ex5.

path.description: Template path from on_vps, e.g. Experts\Vendor\GoldScalper.ex5.

source_url.description: Optional: the vendor page or manual of the EA.

name: discover_ea
description: Read (again) the inputs of a custom EA on the customer's terminal — after the install finished, or after the file was updated. Asynchronous: returns a command_id (get_command). The EA is loaded on a throw-away chart with algo trading off and the chart is closed afterwards; it never trades during discovery. Maps to POST /v1/clients/{client_id}/eas/{custom_id}/discover.

symbol.description: Chart symbol for the discovery chart; default EURUSD.

name: get_ea_draft
description: The discovered inputs (name, type, default, enum_candidate) and the draft profile of a custom EA: per input a label, description, category (risk / entry / exit / filters / news / time / display / licence / magic / other), is_risk, changeable, hidden, suggested min/max/step, enum_labels (confirmed) or enum_guess (AI guess, NOT confirmed), plus kill_switch, magic_input, symbols_allowed, default_symbol/timeframe, presets and terminal journal lines (licence errors show up here). Review it with the customer by category, risk first, in chunks of at most ten inputs; hide cosmetic inputs. Maps to GET /v1/clients/{client_id}/eas/{custom_id}.

name: update_ea_draft
description: Save the customer's corrections to a custom EA's draft: per input label / description / category / is_risk / changeable / hidden / requires_flat / min / max / step / allowed / enum_labels (index → option name, exactly as the customer names them, in order) / type (int|double|enum), plus kill_switch {input, off_value, on_value}, magic_input, symbols_allowed, default_symbol, default_timeframe, presets [{id, label, description, inputs}], default_preset, name, description, category, source_url. A dropdown (enum_candidate) without confirmed enum_labels stays locked; the customer can also allow only some options with `allowed`. Maps to PATCH /v1/clients/{client_id}/eas/{custom_id}/draft.

name: confirm_ea
description: Activate a custom EA after the customer approved the draft: it joins THEIR catalog (ea_id = custom_id) and works with start_ea / set_risk / set_param within the confirmed ranges. Requires at least one symbol in symbols_allowed and discovered inputs. Restart safety stays `untested`: parameter changes while the EA has open positions are refused until AlgoHand verifies it — tell the customer. Accepts the same optional corrections as update_ea_draft. Maps to POST /v1/clients/{client_id}/eas/{custom_id}/confirm.

name: create_support_ticket
description: Open a support ticket for the customer when the problem is beyond your tools: an error you cannot explain from the data, a billing, licence or account question, a suspected bug, a complaint, or when the customer asks for a human. Not for things you can do yourself. Tell the customer what you will send and get a yes first. The support assistant answers within about a minute by e-mail and on the ticket page (`link`); a person takes over when needed. Maps to POST /v1/clients/{client_id}/support/tickets.

message.description: The customer's question in their words plus the facts already established (account, EA, command ids, error codes, what was tried).

email.description: Only when the customer has no dashboard account: where the answer goes. Ask for it in that case.

context.description: Optional; `summary` = one paragraph summarising the conversation so far.

name: list_alerts
description: The customer's alert rules (status, fired count, last value) and the catalog of alert kinds with their parameter names. Call before creating or changing alerts. Maps to GET /v1/clients/{client_id}/alerts.

name: create_alert
description: Create an alert rule after the customer confirmed how you understood it. Kinds and params: balance_below/balance_above/equity_below/equity_above/floating_pnl_below/floating_pnl_above {value}; drawdown_pct {pct} (equity drawdown from the peak since the rule was set); daily_loss_pct {pct}; margin_level_below {pct}; positions_above {count}; ea_off_chart {ea_id|instance_id optional}; deal_closed {min_abs_profit optional} (every closed deal); terminal_disconnected; vps_offline {vps_id optional}; command_failed; price {symbol, level, direction: above|below} (stored; works from agent 0.2.23); news_guard {before_min (30), after_min (15), impact: high|medium, currencies: 'auto' (from the EAs' symbols) | 'all' | [list], targets: 'all' | {instance_ids: [...]} | {symbols: [...]}, match (event title contains, e.g. 'Non-Farm' or 'FOMC'), action: pause|notify} — pauses the EAs (soft stop, positions keep being managed) before the news and resumes them after; notifies in Telegram at every step. account_id is needed when the customer has several accounts. Delivery: Telegram when linked, else e-mail. Maps to POST /v1/clients/{client_id}/alerts.

text.description: The rule in the customer's words, short (shown in every notification).

repeat.description: true = notify again after cooldown_s while the condition holds; false (default) = once, re-armed when the condition clears.

name: update_alert
description: Pause (status=paused) or resume (status=armed) an alert, or change its text/params/channels/repeat/cooldown. Maps to PATCH /v1/clients/{client_id}/alerts/{alert_id}.

name: delete_alert
description: Delete an alert rule (ask for a yes first). Maps to DELETE /v1/clients/{client_id}/alerts/{alert_id}.

name: list_news
description: Upcoming economic calendar events (title, currency, time in UTC, impact, forecast, previous) for the next `hours` (default 48), optionally filtered by currencies. Use it to answer 'what news is coming', to pick the event for a news guard, or to explain why an EA was paused. Maps to GET /v1/news.
